node.question: Does the image show the background changed into a basketball court?
node.criteria: Use only the saved statuses and image-grounded evidence from n1 and n2. complete: n1 passes—the background is recognizably a basketball court. partial: n1 fails and n2 passes—there is specific progress toward a basketball-court background, but it is not complete. absent: n1 fails and n2 fails—no requested change has progressed. unknown: either support is unknown, or the evidence does not establish which of complete, partial, or absent applies. A known negative observation is evidence, not uncertainty; unrelated edits do not count as progress.
